product_ref: required; your own id for the line; rows sharing one are variants of it
product_name: required; the line, as a shopper would see it
sku: required; unique per row; what everybody outside your systems says
variant_name: required; what distinguishes this row from its siblings
is_base: required; true on exactly one row per product reference
category: required; one of the codes on the Categories sheet
claims: optional; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
compliance.sale_permitted: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; true or false
identifiers.gtin: required by CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B; 14 digits, kept as text - leading zeros are significant
textile.fibre_composition: optional; order is part of the value; do not sort; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
image.HERO: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
image.DETAIL: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
example_note: ignored on the way in; delete the column or leave it
